settings.question: Do I have to take the SUF-CPT first?
settings.answer: No. You can start with either Level 2 certification — Soft Tissue Mobilization or Nutrition Coaching — without taking the SUF-CPT first. And because Level 2 gives you access to the entire SUF Library, you get every course and every call, including all the Level 1 material, the moment you enroll.

settings.question: Do you offer payment plans?
settings.answer: Yes — you can pay over time with Affirm at checkout. A quick soft credit check (no impact to your score) shows the plans you qualify for.
